import re, pathlib
base=pathlib.Path('/tmp/openclaw-research')
pages=base/'pages'; repo=base/'repo'
full=re.compile(r'((?:pages|src|docs)/[A-Za-z0-9_./-]+\.(?:md|ts)):(\d+)(?:-(\d+))?')
short=re.compile(r'`:(\d+)(?:-(\d+))?`')
files=['09-multi-agent-and-delegation.md','10-autonomous-programs.md','11-channels-and-routing.md']
problems=[]; checked=0
for name in files:
    text=pathlib.Path(name).read_text().splitlines()
    last=None
    for ln,line in enumerate(text,1):
        # full tokens first (left to right)
        spans=[]
        for m in full.finditer(line):
            spans.append((m.start(),'full',m))
        for m in short.finditer(line):
            spans.append((m.start(),'short',m))
        for pos,kind,m in sorted(spans):
            if kind=='full':
                p=m.group(1); a=int(m.group(2)); b=int(m.group(3) or a); last=p
            else:
                if not last:
                    problems.append(f'{name}:{ln}: shorthand without full token'); continue
                p=last; a=int(m.group(1)); b=int(m.group(2) or a)
            path=pages/p if p.startswith('pages/') else repo/p
            if not path.exists():
                problems.append(f'{name}:{ln}: MISSING {p}'); continue
            n=sum(1 for _ in path.open(errors='ignore'))
            if b>n:
                problems.append(f'{name}:{ln}: OUT OF RANGE {p}:{a}-{b} (file {n} lines)')
            checked+=1
print('citations checked:',checked)
print('problems:',len(problems))
for x in problems[:30]: print(' -',x)

for name in files:

---

Managed worktrees give an agent task its own git branch and checkout without placing temporary directories inside the source repository. OpenClaw records them in the shared state database and snapshots their tracked and non-ignored untracked contents before ordinary removal. [Capacity eviction](#capacity-and-eviction) also preserves the checkout if its recovery snapshot cannot be completed.

Projects cloned by OpenClaw always start new sessions in managed worktrees,
including requests that omit `worktree` or set it to `false`. The shared clone is
the maintenance-owned source for refreshes, Git objects, and templates. The
project picker offers **New worktree** for these clones; explicitly registered
folders and agent workspaces can still use **Current checkout**. Opening a
repository URL also allocates a managed worktree.

five seconds of elapsed time, even if the system wall clock moves backward.

checkout. Choosing the recent source again starts the next session in the same
selected folder.

import re, pathlib

problems=[]; checked=0
for name in files:
    text=pathlib.Path(name).read_text().splitlines()
    last=None
    for ln,line in enumerate(text,1):
        # full tokens first (left to right)
        spans=[]
        for m in full.finditer(line):
            spans.append((m.start(),'full',m))
        for m in short.finditer(line):
            spans.append((m.start(),'short',m))
        for pos,kind,m in sorted(spans):
            if kind=='full':
                p=m.group(1); a=int(m.group(2)); b=int(m.group(3) or a); last=p
            else:
                if not last:
                    problems.append(f'{name}:{ln}: shorthand without full token'); continue
                p=last; a=int(m.group(1)); b=int(m.group(2) or a)
            path=pages/p if p.startswith('pages/') else repo/p
            if not path.exists():
                problems.append(f'{name}:{ln}: MISSING {p}'); continue
            n=sum(1 for _ in path.open(errors='ignore'))
            if b>n:
                problems.append(f'{name}:{ln}: OUT OF RANGE {p}:{a}-{b} (file {n} lines)')

print('citations checked:',checked)

print('total problems:',len(problems))
